description.value: ATLAS Steak + Fish is a modern, upscale steakhouse chain located inside Cascades Casino Kamloops, offering a casually-elegant take on the classic North American steakhouse with seafood, steaks, and craft cocktails. Part of Gateway Casinos' restaurant group, the Kamloops location welcomes minors and operates as a destination dining venue with table-side service and globally-inspired cuisine. Touring cyclists looking for a sit-down dinner will find it on Versatile Drive in a casino complex with full-service dining and takeout.
